items.escena: A stubby clay magnifying glass resting directly on one raised line of an open clay page, the line lifted slightly under the lens
An open clay page with a fat translucent clay bubble floating above it, tied to two separate lines of the page by thin clay threads
A small clay balance scale standing on top of an open clay book, weighing the book's own page on one of its pans
Two clay stone blocks set apart on a base with a hidden clay slab bridging the gap underneath, barely visible from above
A clay figure holding out a document with one hand while the other hand rests on a small clay coin box behind its back
A clay arrow flying past an open clay page without touching it and striking a small clay figure standing behind
A small clay flag planted upright in a clay page, held steady by two thin clay threads knotted to two lifted lines of the text
A small clay flag lying fallen on a clay page, its two threads hanging loose and knotted to nothing
A whole clay book seen from above with a single wide clay ring drawn around all its open pages
A clay hand behind a page pushing a small clay arrow through it toward a target disc on the far side
Two clay pages side by side with differently shaped raised lines, joined by a chunky clay equals sign between them
A clay figure standing firm beside an open clay page, one hand resting on a small planted clay flag
A clay shelf of small closed books behind a reader's open page, one shelf book glowing faintly amber
Two clay footprints pressed into clay ground with a clay figure modelled faintly between them, unfinished
